verdicts.explanation: Table I lists the conductivity column in composition order (Not measurable, 5.0 x 10-6, 7.2 x 10-6, 2.0 x 10-4, 1.2 x 10-5), so 5.0 x 10-6 S/cm belongs to x=0.25 (Li6.75La3Zr1.75Bi0.25O12). The 27 °C measurement, AC impedance, Pechini synthesis and 900 °C / 10 h sintering all match the paper, and the null relative density is acceptable because the table gives only a fraction.

The fourth Table I entry in composition order, 7.2 x 10-6 S/cm, maps to x=0.5 (Li6.5La3Zr1.5Bi0.5O12). Temperature, origin (measured in this work), Pechini method and 900 °C / 10 h sintering are all supported.

The value 2.0 x 10-4 S/cm is the x=0.75 entry (Li6.25La3Zr1.25Bi0.75O12) in Table I. The text independently states that this composition has the highest measured ionic conductivity, which confirms the mapping. Other fields match the paper.
The last entry, 1.2 x 10-5 S/cm, corresponds to x=1.0 (Li6La3ZrBiO12) in Table I. The 27 °C measurement, experimental origin, total conductivity kind and processing conditions all match the paper.
